# TestScript for 17-config-profiles
# Asserts conga.ConfigFile with multi:"true" multi-file merging (repeatable and sep-delimited forms)

# 1. Multi-file merge via repeated -c flags: later files override earlier ones
exec profiles -c deploy/base.yaml -c deploy/prod.yaml
stdout '⚙  profiles'
stdout '-c, --config-files\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+deploy/base\.yaml, deploy/prod\.yaml\s+● cli --config-file'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+base\.example\.com\s+● config deploy/base\.yaml'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9443\s+● config deploy/prod\.yaml'
stdout '--log-level\s+string\s+warn\s+● config deploy/prod\.yaml'

# 2. --why lists both loaded files and each value's winning tier
exec profiles -c deploy/base.yaml -c deploy/prod.yaml --why
stdout '--host\s+base\.example\.com\s+config \[1\]'
stdout '--port\s+9443\s+config \[2\]'
stdout '--log-level\s+warn\s+config \[2\]'
stdout '\[1\] .*/deploy/base\.yaml\s+\(loaded\)'
stdout '\[2\] .*/deploy/prod\.yaml\s+\(loaded\)'
! stdout '██████'

# 3. Comma-separated file list in a single flag
exec profiles -c 'deploy/base.yaml,deploy/prod.yaml'
stdout '-c, --config-files\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+deploy/base\.yaml, deploy/prod\.yaml\s+● cli --config-file'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9443\s+● config deploy/prod\.yaml'

# 4. Search-path fallback: Cascading() merges all existing fallback files
#    (lowest precedence first) instead of single-file first-found resolution
exec profiles
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+9443\s+● config deploy/prod\.yaml'
stdout '--host\s+string\s+base\.example\.com\s+● config deploy/base\.yaml'

-- deploy/base.yaml --
host: base.example.com
port: 9000
log_level: debug

-- deploy/prod.yaml --
port: 9443
log_level: warn
